summary: A pad to sign with a pointer, a finger or a pen; the line thins as it speeds up. Undo takes back one stroke.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after each stroke, undo and clear: the signature as a transparent PNG, or `null` once empty.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The line under the pad, until someone signs.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Names the pad for screen readers.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the pad and its buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns drawing off and dims the pad.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
